cards.front: What are the three main categories of metals?
cards.back: Ferrous metals, non-ferrous metals, and alloys.

cards.front: What is the difference between ferrous and non-ferrous metals?
cards.back: Ferrous metals contain iron, while non-ferrous metals do not contain iron.

cards.front: What are the properties of steel?
cards.back: High strength, durability, malleability, and good corrosion resistance.

cards.front: What is the purpose of annealing in metalwork?
cards.back: To soften metal, relieve stress, and improve machinability.

cards.front: What are the basic metalworking tools?
cards.back: Hammers, files, chisels, drills, and measuring instruments.

cards.front: What is the importance of safety in metalwork?
cards.back: To prevent injuries, protect health, and ensure proper work practices.

cards.front: What are the different types of metal cutting methods?
